extracted.intended_audience: general public; consumers seeking reliable health information; educators or publishers who may reprint NIH material
extracted.subtask_description: A monthly consumer-health newsletter issue from the NIH presenting short articles, health capsules, and prevention guidance intended for the general public and for organizations that may reprint the material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reprint and attribution policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Reprint our articles and illustrations in your own publication. Our material is not copyrighted. Please acknowledge NIH News in Health as the source and send us a copy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Material may be reprinted freely, but reprints must include an acknowledgment naming 'NIH News in Health' as the source and the reprinting party should send a copy of the publication to the NIH Office of Communications and Public Liaison (contact information provided on the page).
